title: Creative catalogue: thirty visual intros
status_note: The following banks were materialized from the 10 October 2026 catalogue and are preserved here as usable text. They remain proposals. The catalogue's earlier statement that a second film was in progress and that zero twelve-style slots were qualified is a historical assembly snapshot; it is not today's completed-film ledger. This guide does not retroactively mark individual catalogue recipes rendered because a similarly named film exists.

records.first_frame: A toppled original prop fills the frame.
records.action: Hold briefly, trace back to the initiating contact.

records.first_frame: The same simple setup appears left and right.
records.action: Both begin together; a single changed parameter is highlighted.
records.sound: Shared pulse with separate result accents.

records.first_frame: A small character crosses a richly rendered scene toward an obstacle.
records.action: Camera tracks at walking speed and settles before the decision.

records.first_frame: An honest silhouette appears on a textured stage.
records.action: Light rotates slowly while the camera stays fixed.

records.first_frame: A complete scene is visible immediately.
records.action: Two meaningful layers peel apart without hiding the subject.

records.first_frame: A distinctive token begins at the first node of a network.
records.action: Track it through one junction, then pause before the next.
records.sound: Single pluck at each verified handoff.

records.first_frame: A character enters carrying an absurdly oversized tool.
records.action: Their confident step stops at the tiny problem.
records.text_seed: There may be an easier way.
records.sound: Small comic stop and room tone.

records.first_frame: A physical indicator or step result is framed clearly.
records.action: Pull back to show the action it checks.
records.text_seed: How would you know it worked?
records.sound: Neutral click matched to the indicator.

records.first_frame: A sourced warning cue is visible in an otherwise calm scene.
records.action: A bounded highlight draws attention, then stops.

records.first_frame: A fictional route is shown as a clean map.
records.action: Dissolve to the same route in an original miniature scene.
records.text_seed: The map leaves out one thing.

records.first_frame: The scene and two options are already legible.
records.action: A gentle progress bar begins after the rule appears.
records.sound: Soft regular ticks, optional silent mode.

records.first_frame: An object sits with one clearly empty socket.
records.action: A slow turn reveals the gap from a second view.

records.first_frame: An original tap is paired with a visible waveform.
records.action: The waveform settles into the moving object that made the sound.

records.first_frame: A character steps out from behind an actual scene edge.
records.action: Camera holds while they discover the central prop.
records.sound: Footstep, breath and small music motif.

records.first_frame: A circular everyday object fills the screen.
records.action: Match cut to a different-scale system with the same silhouette.

records.first_frame: The external object is visible against a calm background.
records.action: A cutaway plane opens to show the interacting parts.

records.first_frame: Three repeated actions establish a visual rhythm.
records.action: A fourth object breaks one stated rule.
records.sound: Three even taps and a held rest.

records.first_frame: A final object rests beside three traces of its journey.
records.action: The camera follows the traces backward without reversing physics.
records.sound: Music starts on the resolved chord then thins.

records.first_frame: Two characters look at the same object from different sides.
records.action: A small orbit reveals why each saw something different.
records.text_seed: They both saw part of it.
records.sound: Two short vocal reactions, optional captions.

records.first_frame: A tool begins one approved, safe action.
records.action: The title arrives in empty space after the action is recognizable.
records.sound: Real or original matched tool sound.

records.first_frame: An obstruction dominates near frame while the goal remains visible.
records.action: Slow lateral move reveals a plausible path.
records.sound: Ambient sound with one discovery accent.

records.first_frame: A simple shape is drawn around the key object.
records.action: The outline becomes a guide for the later explanation.

records.first_frame: A tiny character stands beside a large, grounded object.
records.action: Wide shot holds before a closer insert of their tool.

records.first_frame: An authentic capture or labeled mockup opens at a known state.
records.action: One highlight indicates the next action, not a fake cursor success.
records.sound: Clear spoken step and quiet click.

records.first_frame: Three dated or explicitly fictional time panels sit together.
records.action: The middle panel expands into the main scene.

records.first_frame: The central action sits low in a spacious scene.
records.action: A short question appears above without covering evidence.

records.first_frame: Two objects are just about to touch.
records.action: A character interrupts at the last moment and creates a new problem.
records.sound: Held note and soft comic release.

records.first_frame: A character demonstrates the fictional rule once in plain view.
records.action: A second attempt introduces the conflict.

records.first_frame: A real or clearly simulated failed result sits beside a corrected proposal.
records.action: Camera moves to the single changed region.

records.first_frame: A foreground character starts a solitary task.
records.action: Slow push keeps a helpful background action visible.
records.sound: Gentle ambient music, no forced crescendo.
